newsitem.title: MEXICO: PANAMCO Q2 NET PROFIT RISES.
newsitem.headline: PANAMCO Q2 NET PROFIT RISES.

text.p: Mexico-based Coca-Cola bottler Panamerican Beverages Inc (Panamco) reported second quarter earnings of $40.4 million on Monday, compared to $26.8 million in the year-ago quarter.

Earnings per share were $0.34 compared to $0.27 per share during the second quarter of 1996, the company said in a statement. Earnings per share were based on 118.8 million weighted average shares outstanding, it added.
Panamco's quarterly net sales grew to $566.6 million from $460.7 million during the second quarter of 1996, it said.
During the quarter, Panamco's operating profits grew to $49.7 million from $40.6 million in the year-ago quarter.
The company said its second quarter included two months of results from Panamco's recently acquired Venezuelan subsidiary.
It said in a separate statement that it had declared a regular quarterly dividend of $0.0525 per share. The record date is September 15, 1997 and the payment date is September 29, 1997.
Panamco is one of the world's largest Coca-Cola bottlers, with operations in most of Latin America.
